text.title: PR Mentoring Session Protocol — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps for one mentoring session on one PR: pick the single learning goal from the prior record, anchor the observed gap to a diff line, post labelled comments with at least one praise, have the junior restate the gap and author the fix, park unrelated findings, name the follow-up PR and window, get the junior's confirmation and share the record, then close it when the follow-up PR lands.

step.name: open-session-from-prior-record
step.input: The junior's open PR; the prior session record for the same junior, if any; the follow-up PR that record named.
step.action: Fill `session` (one `pr_url`, `junior`, `senior`, `date`, `evaluation_use`). If a prior record exists, judge its follow-up PR and set `progression.prior_record_url`, `prior_action_status`, `not_demonstrated_streak`; link the prior record in `evidence[]`.
step.decision-gate: Prior goal `not-demonstrated`: keep the same `learning_goal`; a streak of 3 changes the intervention and escalates in `decision` (r-progression-linked-to-prior-session).

step.name: state-one-observable-goal
step.input: The prior goal, or the most consequential gap visible in the diff.
step.action: Write `learning_goal` as one code behaviour the next PR can show; park any second skill for another session.
step.decision-gate: Attitude wording ("be more careful", "think about edge cases") or two skills is rejected (r-one-observable-learning-goal).

step.name: anchor-the-gap-to-a-line
step.input: The diff; the review comment thread.
step.action: Write `observed_gap.did` and `should` about the code, and add the diff-line or comment anchor (`#discussion_r...`, `#L...`, `#note_...`) to `evidence[]`.
step.decision-gate: A gap about the person, or no line anchor, is rejected (r-observed-gap-cites-diff-line, fm-gap-is-a-trait).

step.name: post-labelled-comments
step.input: The PR review interface; the Conventional Comments labels.
step.action: Post every comment with a label as its first word; at least one `praise` on a specific line the junior got right; count them into `comment_counts`.
step.decision-gate: Nitpicks outnumbering all other labels combined: set `session_outcome: learning_goal_not_addressed`, move the nits to a formatter or linter task, and re-run on the one `issue` (r-comments-labelled-with-counts, fm-nit-storm).

step.name: junior-restates-and-fixes
step.input: The junior on the call or in the thread.
step.action: Ask the junior to restate the gap in their own words; record it as `restated_gap`. The junior writes and pushes the fix; record `fix_commit.url` and `author`. The senior pushes nothing to the branch.
step.decision-gate: A fix commit authored by the senior fails the session (r-junior-restates-and-writes-the-fix, fm-senior-rewrites-the-code).

step.name: park-deferred-findings
step.input: Everything else noticed in the diff that is unrelated to the goal.
step.action: Record each as `deferred_findings[]` (line URL plus one line) and post them as ordinary review comments after the session.
step.decision-gate: A second PR in the same session is a second record (r-session-scoped-to-one-pr-and-goal).

step.name: name-follow-up-and-share
step.action: Write `decision.follow_up_action` as the behaviour the junior will show, `demonstrate_in.window` (at most 14 days or `next-two-prs`), and the ticket or PR URL if it already exists; add `escalation` when the streak is 3. Store the record where the junior can read it, get their confirmation of `observed_gap` and `decision` as a comment, reaction or co-authorship, record `junior_confirmation`, and commit with `status: open`. Fill `templates/skeleton.md.j2`; run `scripts/validate-pr-mentoring-session-protocol.py --file`.
step.output: Committed open record with the junior's confirmation.
step.decision-gate: "Keep this in mind", a window above 14 days, or no confirmation blocks the commit (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr, r-record-shared-with-junior).

step.name: close-on-follow-up-pr
step.input: The follow-up PR when it opens.
step.action: Add its URL to `decision.demonstrate_in.url` and `evidence[]`; set `status: closed`. Its review becomes step 1 of the next session, which judges `prior_action_status`.
step.output: Closed record; input for the next session.
step.decision-gate: The window passes with no PR: keep the record open and raise it at the next 1:1; do not close without a URL (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr).

list.item: Record validates via `scripts/validate-pr-mentoring-session-protocol.py`, including the fix-author, nit-storm, streak and window checks.
The junior has confirmed the gap and decision text and can open the record.
`status` is `closed` with the follow-up PR URL, or `open` with the window still running.
